gloss: real pleasure; true delight; essence of enjoyment

definitions.gloss: real pleasure; true delight; the best part
definitions.explanation: The essential appeal or greatest enjoyment of something. Used to highlight what makes an experience truly worthwhile or deeply satisfying.

examples.japanese: {旅|たび}の{醍醐味|だいごみ}は{出会|であ}いだ。
examples.english: The real pleasure of travel is the encounters.

examples.japanese: ライブで{聴|き}く{音楽|おんがく}には{独特|どくとく}の{醍醐味|だいごみ}がある。
examples.english: Listening to music live has a unique appeal.

examples.japanese: {自分|じぶん}で{釣|つ}った{魚|さかな}をその{場|ば}で{焼|や}いて{食|た}べるのが、キャンプの{醍醐味|だいごみ}だと{思|おも}う。
examples.english: I think the true delight of camping is catching your own fish and grilling it on the spot.

notes:
{醍醐味|だいごみ} originally comes from Buddhist terminology. {醍醐|だいご} refers to the finest essence of milk (clarified butter or ghee), regarded as the most refined and purest substance. By extension, the word came to mean the ultimate or quintessential pleasure of something.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ...の{醍醐味|だいごみ} (the real pleasure of...)
- {醍醐味|だいごみ}を{味|あじ}わう (to savor the true delight)
- {醍醐味|だいごみ}がある (to have a special appeal)

This is a culturally rich word that learners encounter frequently in descriptions of experiences, hobbies, and activities. It goes beyond simple enjoyment to express what makes something uniquely or deeply satisfying.
